page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m16-vws.5xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 20 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with a 33 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 92.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.6 GB per core. Acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core CPU metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core, fall into the weak and poor categories, respectively. However, multi-core CPU performance is average, as demonstrated by the Geekbench multi-core score of 6611.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 15713.85. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the Passmark memory score is weak. The instance handles database operations and static web serving at average throughput levels.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and the inclusion of an NVIDIA T4 GPU, this instance offers a balanced hardware profile for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the high cost of top-tier accelerators. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This server is suited for workloads such as entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks, multi-threaded data processing, and moderate database operations.
